liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds the jamming around The Other One on disc 2 chaotic and melody-less, and the song is instrumental without verses; Reviewer calls the second-set Other One excursion worthwhile [8][11][18]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (2 reviews): Reviewer describes Here Comes Sunshine as shimmering and notes the first set stays tight throughout; Reviewer calls this the best live Here Comes Sunshine [11][18]
- **Cumberland Blues** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Cumberland Blues energetic; Reviewer considers this possibly the hottest Cumberland Blues ever played [10][12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out China Cat into Rider as energetic, alongside Here Comes Sunshine; Reviewer hears fluid China Cat/Rider, with a sweet interstitial jam separating the two songs [10][11]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer praises an early Row Jimmy and a swaying Brown-Eyed Women [18]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer praises a roughly 69-minute stretch from Truckin' through Wharf Rat as a great 1973 jam [15]

## The recordings

- **gd73-11-14.sbd.vernon.5612.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 4.51/5 by 55 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the sound on this recording is great; Reviewer says the sound is better than on 11/11 or 11/17, though all are excellent; Reviewer describes the recording as laid back and sweet [9][16][19]
- **gd1973-11-14.sbd.hollister.14716.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Uploader says this version is far better than the circulating one; notes small static and pops in Row Jimmy and Rider, all non-digital [2]
- **gd1973-11-14.sbd.vernon.clevenger.fix-5612.6197.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1973-11-14.166344.aud.Conner.gems.flac1448**: audience recording; 26 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Reel flips occur during The Other One and Wharf Rat [2]
- Charles was center right with many cops on the perimeter; flips occurred in the second Other One and One More Saturday Night is cut [4]
- Reviewer rates it three stars relative to other Grateful Dead shows, saying plenty of better material exists [8]
- Reviewer says the show is overshadowed by the 11/11 show before it and the 11/17 show after it [10]
- Reviewer says the show is nicknamed for the Other One appearing every other song [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-11-14.sbd.vernon.5612.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Lineage: soundboard to master reel to cassette to DAT to CD, then EAC to SHN by Matt Vernon from Eurodead Vine discs [1]
- **gd1973-11-14.sbd.hollister.14716.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Hollister; source: 7" Master Reel > Cassette > CD [2]. Also: Cassette was played on a Nakamichi deck into a Flying Calf 24-bit A/D, then a ZA2, and tracked and burned [2]
- **gd1973-11-14.sbd.vernon.clevenger.fix-5612.6197.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon and Bob Clevenger; source: SBD>MR>Cass>DAT>CDR [3]. Also: Bob Clevenger trimmed some silence and minor tuning from the set 2 tracks to reduce total time [3]
- **gd1973-11-14.166344.aud.Conner.gems.flac1448**: taped by Recorded by Charles Conner from center right; transferred by Mastering on November 13, 2023 by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain; source: Sony ECM-22P mic (mono)> Sony TC-55 > BASF C90 master cassettes [4]. Also: First audience recording of this show to circulate; taped by Charles, with tape flips left unpatched [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by blogbujero.blogspot.com: [(000948)Grateful Dead San Diego Sports Arena, San Diego, CA 1973-11-14](https://blogbujero.blogspot.com/2022/09/grateful-dead-san-diego-sports-arena.html) [21]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead 30 Trips Around The Sun 1973 San Diego Sports Arena CA 11/14/73 | #4629811884](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-30-trips-around-sun-4629811884) [22]
- Fan art by Bob Morris Grateful Dead: [1973-11-14 San Diego Sports Arena, San Diego, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-11-14-san-diego-sports-arena-san-diego-ca-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by rirocks.net: [Grateful Dead 1973 09.14](https://rirocks.net/Band%20Articles/Grateful%20Dead%201973%2009.14%20-%20Prov.%20Civic%20Center.htm) [24]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 11/14/73 San Diego Sports Arena…](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759945723/) [25]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759945723/) [26]
